_comment: SANITIZED example of the undrudge-dispatch config. The real config (~/.config/undrudge-dispatch/config.json) names sensitive internal projects and machine paths and is gitignored — this public repo only carries the shape. Routes map recommendations to recipient dirs: git routes WITHOUT an explicit 'dir' get a managed clone under clones_dir (cloned on demand, so triage never collides with a working checkout); an explicit 'dir' is the exception (a pinned existing clone, or a non-git/in-place target).
_comment_denylist: false = shadow mode: deny-list matches are reported only, recs flow normally. Flip to true to enact.

routes.name: pinned-repo
routes._comment: exception: a pinned existing clone instead of a managed one (e.g. a large monorepo already synced)

routes.name: managed-repo
routes._comment: no 'dir' -> managed clone at <clones_dir>/managed-repo, cloned on demand

routes.name: approval-only-repo
routes._comment: auto=false -> always held for human approval in the vault queue

routes.name: in-place-private
routes._comment: non-git / sensitive / local-only: explicit dir, no sync; implemented in place

routes.name: vault
routes._comment: agent_global recs land here; the devlog session handles them via /undrudge-queue

routes.name: held-sensitive
routes._comment: sensitive zone: hold for approval, never stage
